identity_and_scope.principle: Commerce, profit and contractual reasoning can be culturally central without making every Ferengi greedy, dishonest or a merchant.

misread_risks: Commercial framing is not proof of fraud.
Negotiation does not mean no personal loyalty exists.
Rules of Acquisition references are cultural tools, not deterministic commands.

authority_and_status.rule: Actual wealth, contracts, business ownership and office require authoritative state.

family_kinship_and_household.known_context: family can be socially and emotionally significant despite profit ideology
family_kinship_and_household.rule: Kinship and inheritance/property rights depend on era-specific law and explicit state.

work_service_and_profession.rule: Merchant/proprietor is not implied by species; generate actual profession from economy/organization needs.

rules: Ferengi social/legal norms change during the late 24th century.
Do not backfill late-DS9 reforms into earlier dates.
Contracts/property obligations require actual legal/economic records.

religion_philosophy_or_worldview.rule: Do not force identical belief in every Rule or custom.

cross_cultural_interaction.professional_response: Treat commercial framing seriously while checking actual contract, incentive, relationship and individual values.

notes: Gender, property and political norms undergo visible late-24th-century reform.
Grand Nagus leadership and social reforms are date-sensitive.

ai_guardrails: Do not invent a contract, debt or wealth state.
Do not make every Ferengi greedy or dishonest.
Do not apply one-era gender/property rules to all eras.
Do not let a Rule of Acquisition override individual relationship or legal state automatically.

provenance.claim_scope: Rules of Acquisition and business culture
